name: B10-0279/2026 (ESN) – Implementation of the Urban Wastewater Treatment Directive (UWWTD) and risks to the security of supply of medicines
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the implementation of the Urban Wastewater Treatment Directive (UWWTD) and risks to the security of supply of medicines
part_text:
This text is a request from a group in the European Parliament, not a change in the law. It asks the European Commission to rethink its plan for treating city wastewater. It wants countries and local councils to have more freedom in how they meet the rules. It also warns that making medicine makers pay towards water clean-up could raise medicine prices or cause shortages, and asks for cheap generic medicines to be left out.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It asks the Commission to revise its wastewater plan and exempt generic medicines from clean-up fees.
- **Who it affects:** National and local governments, water companies, medicine makers, and patients.
- **What happens next:** The Parliament votes on this request, then sends it to the Council and the Commission.
